desc: Words in s are separated by one or more spaces; leading and trailing spaces are ignored. width >= 1. Wrap the words into lines greedily: words on a line are separated by single spaces, and the next word is added to the current line if the line's length afterwards is at most width; otherwise that word starts a new line. A word longer than width is never split: it goes on its own line (the line before it ends, and the next word starts a new line). Return the lines in order; if s has no words, return an empty list.
